results.title: Droupadi Murmu becomes first President to address Odisha Assembly - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: constitutional_authority/state: First President to address Odisha Assembly; historical first for constitutional office.

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: President Droupadi Murmu became the first President of India to address the Odisha Legislative Assembly, returning to the house where she began her legislative career in 2000.
notes.fact_box: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the Odisha Legislative Assembly on Thursday, having previously addressed assemblies in Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra. She was adjudged the best legislator in 2007, becoming the first woman MLA from Odisha to receive the honor.

prelims_pointers.text: President Murmu began her legislative career in the year 2000
The President received an additional Rs. 800 per quintal as an input subsidy over and above the MSP for paddy in Odisha
Subhadra scheme: A state initiative in Odisha for women's empowerment
President Murmu was adjudged the best legislator in 2007

notes.mains_question: Discuss the significance of the President's role in fostering federal cooperation and the symbolic importance of the Head of State's interaction with State Legislatures.
mains_dimensions: Constitutional symbolism: The President's role as the formal head of the Union and its role in reinforcing the federal structure.
Legislative dignity: The importance of maintaining decorum in state assemblies as public scrutiny via online streaming increases.
Empowerment narrative: The transition of tribal representation from grassroots legislative roles to the highest constitutional office.
dropped: pointer: Droupadi Murmu is the current President of India [trivia]

results.title: Manipur's violence-hit people, seeking to return home, clash with security forces - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: internal_security/national: Ongoing ethnic violence and security situation in Manipur.

notes.subject: security
notes.why_in_news: Displaced people in Manipur clashed with security forces at Yaingangpokpi while attempting to return to their homes in the Senapati district.
notes.fact_box: The clashes occurred in Imphal East district on November 29, 2025, involving internally displaced persons (IDPs) who have been in relief camps since ethnic violence began in May 2023. Security forces used tear gas shells to disperse agitators at the Yaingangpokpi location.

prelims_pointers.text: Imphal East and Senapati are districts in the state of Manipur.
Ethnic violence in Manipur began in May 2023.
The Sangai Festival began on November 21, 2025.

notes.mains_question: Examine the challenges in managing internal displacement and restoring communal harmony in conflict-affected regions like Manipur.
mains_dimensions: Security-Civilian friction: Conflict between the state's claim of 'normalcy' and the lived reality of IDPs seeking safe return.
Logistical bottleneck: Difficulty in establishing secure corridors for displaced populations in ethnically polarized zones.
Institutional trust deficit: Erosion of public confidence in state-led security measures during post-conflict rehabilitation.
